notes:
Summary: mid-market analytics SaaS provider evaluating Redwood for productionizing ML-driven UX (in-app chat, recommendations, similarity search). Started with Hosted API evaluation (Jan demo) -> agreed to test Dedicated for production performance/cost predictability. Key ask: predictable p95/p99 latency for chat and fallbacks for outages.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-10-05: Intro call (AE Maya Chen, SE Jordan Patel). baseline needs capture.
- 2025-10-12: Hosted API demo + walkthrough. team liked streaming + function calling.
- 2025-11-04: Pricing follow-up email; customer requests cost model for 500k req/mo chat workload. (see gmail thread-0b34f9d7e1)
- 2026-01-14: Security questionnaire submitted. SOC2 + SSO + KMS required. Redwood provided SOC2 attestation stub.
- 2026-01-28: Technical deep-dive w/ infra and platform team. collected seq length distribution, token per request, tail latency targets.
- 2026-02-11: Demo of Dedicated beta; SE ran throughput test (multi-GPU). Customer: "need consistent 95th/99th percentile — <200ms p95, <350ms p99 for short chats".
- 2026-02-15: Decision to run 4-week Dedicated POC. Fireflies call ff_20260215_8372Z contains POC kickoff transcript.

POC scope / acceptance criteria:
- Duration: 4 weeks (prod-like traffic replay).
- Topology: Dedicated node pool in US-EAST primary, EU region as passive failover. VPC peering to their infra.
- Canary plan: week1 canary routes 5% traffic to Dedicated pool (small slice), monitors latency/error/quality. Gradually increase to 50% by week2 if metrics stable.
- Routing/fallback: primary route Dedicated->model-variant-A (fp16 quant), fallback path to Hosted API model-variant-B (smaller q4_0) in same region then EU-hosted for region failover.
- Rollback criteria: sustained error-rate spike >2x baseline for 10m OR p99 latency >2x baseline OR eval-set quality drop >5% (automated eval harness).
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost per request, error rate, model-quality diffs on blue/green eval set, KV cache hit rate.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML) integration with Okta.
- KMS integration required for customer-managed keys.
- Data residency: EU customer records must stay in EU region; Redwood routing must respect residency tags.
- Audit logging & 90-day retention for request logs requested.

Pricing / commercial:
- Customer evaluating base Dedicated node pricing + per-token discounted tier. Considering 12-month commit if SLA for latency is provided. Wants line-item for burst capacity.
- AE proposed estimate: $120k ARR committed + variable usage; engineering to provide exact sizing after POC results.

Quotes / customer voice:
- "If we can't get predictable p99 under load we can't move to dedicated; inconsistent latency breaks our UX."
- "We need a clear rollback story — show us playbook for canary fail and region failover."

Open action items / next steps:
- Redwood: produce Dedicated sizing worksheet (by 2026-03-03).
- Customer: provide anonymized production traffic sample (by 2026-03-01) for sizing + replay.
- Legal: finalize DPA + residency addendum (pending).
- SEs: prepare canary routing runbook and automated rollback playbook; include model variant mapping and KV-cache sync notes.

Attachments / refs: pricing deck (drive link), POC runbook stub, infra checklist, security questionnaire. Jira tickets INF-4127 (POC infra), SEC-2241 (KMS onboarding).
